main_text.p: פּוֹחַ Afflare, Aspirare. Hiphil הפִּיחַ Conflare, Sufflare, Exsufflare, Efflare: metaphoricè Effari: item Illaqueare.
פַּח m. Laqueus: plur. מַחִים פַּח Laquei, Lamina.
פּוּךְ m. Fucus, qui ad venustatem comparandam adhibetur: item Carbunculus aut Rubinus, lapis pretiosus.
פּם פִּים m. Chald. Oris, Dan. 6. 18: בְּפֻמָּא Ore suo, Dan. 7. 5.
פֵּן Ne forte, Ne, ut ne, ut non, quandoque haesitantis, quandoq; simpliciter negantis particula.
פּוּץ Spargi, Dispergi, Spargere se. Niphal נפּוּץ Idem. Pihel פִּוֹצֵץ & פּוּצֵץ Dispergi, Disilire fecit, Dissipavit. Hiphil הפִּיץ Dispersit. Hithpahel התפּוּצֵץ Dissipari.
פּוּק Titubavit, Vacillavit. Hiphil הפִּיק Vacillare

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words were transcribed as far as legible; the Hebrew vowel points are approximate due to scan quality. Left margin has some faint marks, not text.
